representation_fit.evidence: Brief demands a single high-consequence flow (complete, zero-mistake, workflow object). Implementation is a 9-step / 3-phase cutover runbook executor: linear step cards with risk badges (source/data.js:16-198), irreversible lifecycle armed→locked with undo window and manual recovery (source/app.js:87-147), plus audit ledger — a near-canonical representation for one consequential flow with high hierarchy and no comparison/spatial facets.

primary_task_salience.evidence: screenshots/1280x860.png: the current step card (PRE-01 checklist + code transcription + 完成步骤 button) is the dominant center surface; flow map and audit log are side references; header carries only progress/counters.

time_to_understand.evidence: Header subtitle states the job verbatim (「目标：零失误走完全程」, source/index.html:16); progress 0/9 and highlighted current row in map; center card states exactly what blocks completion (「尚未满足：2 项核查未勾选；校验码未誊录核对」) — what/where readable within seconds at both 1280x860 and 1440x900.

navigation_cost.evidence: Primary object (current step) is on screen at load with 0 navigation steps; any other step is one click in the left map (source/app.js:232-237 buttons, 567-572 click handler); single page, no modes.

context_loss.evidence: No routes/reloads: all actions render into the same stage; typed values preserved in state without re-render on input (source/app.js:538-545); completed/locked steps remain reviewable as recaps (app.js:384-423); restart is guarded by a confirm modal (index.html:44-53). Minor: checkbox change re-renders whole stage (app.js:530), dropping focus — cosmetic, not structural.

ui_surface_complexity.evidence: Exactly three permanent surfaces, each with a distinct job: flow map (orientation/progress), stage (work), audit log (evidence for the zero-mistake verdict, app.js:68-69); header chips (不可逆/失误/偏差/timer) all feed the completion judgment (app.js:197-205); controls render disabled until prerequisites met (app.js:347-361). No decorative surfaces.

accessibility.evidence: measurement-summary.json: a11y.contrast=fail, a11y.focus_order=fail, a11y.target_size=fail, type.min_projected_size=fail (4 of 7 checks). Consistent with source: 10-11.5px faint text (source/styles.css:122,62), 16px checkboxes (styles.css:177), low-contrast --faint #5d6b80 on dark panels (styles.css:11). Mitigations exist: :focus-visible outline (styles.css:33), aria-live stage, aria-labels, dialog role (index.html:33-45) — affordances present but measured a11y fails.

frontend_rework.evidence: No visible layout defects: layout.overflow/responsive_collision/text.truncation all pass (measurement-summary.json) and both operator screenshots (1280x860, 1440x900) are clean. However 4 receipt failures (contrast, focus order, target size, min projected size) imply a remediation pass before shipping.

acceptance_seed_coverage.evidence: Seed「不可逆步骤有恢复/确认路径」fully covered and demonstrated: (1) confirmation — mandatory phrase transcription before execute, mismatch counts a mistake (source/data.js:115,144; app.js:87-108; source/screenshots/03-irreversible-confirm-path.png); (2) recovery path A — live undo window 10s/8s with countdown bar (app.js:367-382, 181-192; screenshot 05); (3) recovery path B — post-lock manual recovery HP-01/HP-02 with ordered steps + phrase (data.js:101-114,130-143; app.js:384-404; screenshot 06); (4) reverse-order recovery constraint (app.js:50-52,63,400); (5) gate-block safe stop with abort path (app.js:149-178; screenshot 09).

defects_observed: a11y.contrast fail (measurement-summary.json): faint/muted 10-11.5px text on dark panels, e.g. styles.css:122 (.st-code 10.5px --faint)
a11y.focus_order fail (measurement-summary.json); full-stage innerHTML re-render on checkbox change (app.js:530) drops focus position
a11y.target_size fail (measurement-summary.json): 16px checkboxes (styles.css:177), small pill/badge hit areas (styles.css:202-210,126-130)
type.min_projected_size fail (measurement-summary.json): 10-11.5px type used for step codes, chips, log timestamps (styles.css:122,62,343)
scores.overall_note: The package matches the brief's shape almost exactly: a single high-consequence workflow (9 steps, 3 phases, 2 irreversible) rendered as a step-by-step execution console where the current step dominates the screen at load (screenshots/1280x860.png, 1440x900.png). The acceptance seed is not merely present but structurally enforced — confirmation phrases with mistake accounting (app.js:87-108), a live undo window, post-lock manual recovery procedures HP-01/HP-02 with reverse-order constraints, and a gate-blocked safe stop — all demonstrated in source/screenshots 03/05/06/09/11. Navigation cost is minimal (zero clicks to the primary object, one click to any step) and context is preserved throughout a single-page state machine. The one clear weakness is accessibility: 4 of 7 measured checks fail (contrast, focus order, target size, minimum projected size), traceable to very small low-contrast type and compact controls, implying a rework pass; layout itself is defect-free at both viewports. Task completion time, information retrieval accuracy, and human preference are not observable in blind review, and model judgment of this screen is not a substitute for human preference.
